name: terracecut
does: The Terrace's edge as it was, to compare: walking between the Terrace and the house's rooms, the camera swings some 10 m along the ground and 2 m up and down over 3 m past the Terrace's ring as the house's slide eases in or out, and the mood eases between home's and the forest's under the room.
decision: Ed, 2026-11-12: "there is a camera transition (I think) when going onto the terrace of the treehouse; this isn't required anymore since the treehouse is treated as one area"
